prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the details of the accident, if that's all right.
Q: We'll get there. For the record, can you confirm you're the driver of the vehicle involved?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Thank you. Where did the incident happen?
A: On the main road in Sugar Land, Texas, near one of the big intersections with the shopping center on the corner. I was in the middle lane heading toward the freeway.
Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes to the right because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror and I thought the lane was clear.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle came up on my right side and we sideswiped each other. I felt a bump and heard scraping along my passenger side. Both cars pulled over onto the shoulder.
Q: Was anyone else injured?
A: No one else in my car. The other driver seemed okay, but I was shaken up.
Q: Describe your injuries.
A: My neck snapped back and forward when we hit. It's stiff and sore, and the pain goes up into the back of my head. I've had headaches since that day.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon and they told me it looked like whiplash. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: Did you have your seatbelt on?
A: Yes, I was wearing it.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble turning my head to check blind spots, which is a little scary when I'm driving.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
